TITLE: Legal act
loadError: The legal act could not be loaded
disabled: Disabled — not used in search and analysis
pagesNote: No clause structure was found in this standard: it is indexed and cited by its pages.

CONFIRM.extractText: The AI model reads the current version and proposes obligations for review. Approved obligations are kept. This uses the AI model and costs money.
CONFIRM.verifyText: A second model compares every obligation with the provisions it rests on. It approves nothing — start your review with the doubted ones.
CONFIRM.verifyScope: Only the obligations not checked yet are checked. This uses the AI model and costs money.
CONFIRM.verifyAgainScope: Every obligation of this act has been checked — all of them are checked again. This uses the AI model and costs money.
CONFIRM.reembedText: The act's chunks are embedded again — only needed after the embedding model changed. This costs money.
CONFIRM.deleteText: Every version, provision, chunk and file is deleted. Reports already produced do not change. To stop using the act only for a while, disable it instead.

METHOD.title: How should the structure of “{name}” be read?
METHOD.text: The standard is processed again from the same file. Reviewed requirements stay; proposals whose clauses are no longer there are removed, and the requirements are then extracted anew.
METHOD.label: Way of reading the structure
METHOD.autoHint: Numbered clauses and lettered annexes by rules. Where the rules find no structure, the AI model marks the headings. By pages when neither works.
METHOD.rulesHint: No AI model. A document without numbered clauses is indexed by its pages.
METHOD.aiHint: The AI model marks the headings of the whole text — for a framework with identifiers of its own (AC-2, GV.OC-01) or without numbering. This uses the AI model and costs money.
METHOD.pagesHint: Each page is a unit, cited by its number. No AI model.

UPLOAD.title: New version
UPLOAD.text: Upload the text of the new version (PDF, DOCX, HTML or TXT). A file identical to the current version is refused.

STRUCTURE.notIngested: The act is not ingested yet — its structure appears after ingestion.
STRUCTURE.select: Pick a provision to read its text.

UNIT.title: Provision
UNIT.notCurrent: This provision is from an earlier version (v{version}).

INFO.title: Official title
INFO.scopeReading: Whom it covers, as read from its text
INFO.scopeSilent: Its scope provisions do not say whom it covers
INFO.sanctionsReading: Sanctions, as read from its text
